jobs.title: Review a pull request
jobs.blurb: Findings first, then security, tests, and a description reviewers can act on.

jobs.title: Ship a code change
jobs.blurb: Commit, describe the PR, and keep the trail readable.

jobs.title: Debug a production issue
jobs.blurb: Hypothesize, isolate, and only then patch.

jobs.title: Run a live incident
jobs.blurb: Assign an IC, mitigate first, keep customer copy factual.

jobs.title: Secure something before ship
jobs.blurb: Abuse paths, injection, secrets, and agent hardening.

jobs.title: Design or wrap an API
jobs.blurb: Contracts, errors, and vendor clients without invented endpoints.

jobs.title: Fix a slow query or missing index
jobs.blurb: Rewrite the statement, then add the smallest index that serves it.

jobs.title: Review infra before apply
jobs.blurb: Treat apply as a production change. Prefer plan evidence.

jobs.title: Improve page speed and a11y
jobs.blurb: Fix the dominant Web Vital, then make the UI keyboard-usable.

jobs.title: Ship a mobile or desktop train
jobs.blurb: Version, sign, stage, and know how to halt.

jobs.title: Explain or cut a cloud bill
jobs.blurb: Investigate a spike first; rightsizing is a different job.

jobs.title: Design an experiment before launch
jobs.blurb: Hypothesis, unit, power, then later read the result.

jobs.title: Model warehouse facts and dims
jobs.blurb: One grain per fact. Pipelines and KPIs are adjacent jobs.

jobs.title: Turn an idea into a PRD or RFC
jobs.blurb: Decision-ready scope, then the technical design.

jobs.title: Triage an open-source repo
jobs.blurb: Issues, PRs, and contributor onboarding without burning out.

jobs.title: Harden an AI agent or prompt
jobs.blurb: Rewrite the prompt, eval it, then threat-model tools.

jobs.title: Write a status-page update
jobs.blurb: Facts only. Live command and postmortems are different jobs.

jobs.title: Design multi-region active-active
jobs.blurb: Data plane first. Restore drills and YAML are different jobs.
